Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Hosted Band supports join-code sessions, remote instrument and ARM controls, scheduled playback, relay diagnostics and individual follower START acknowledgements.
Changelog: Hosted Band START confirmations per performer, targeted retry of missing confirmations, duplicate prevention and visible rejection reasons.
